world_sets.row_sizes: per LSR outcome: train 64, validation 16, held-out 32 (4 held-out rows with one real input set to zero); 16 outcomes per LSR family; F1: B-chain 16 and B-alt 16 per draw.

core.what: A1 RECIPE_ONLY: the existing LSR engine at the family's core capacity, nothing changed. Computed through rb_g6 units_g6's stage-0 LSR unit code (rb_g5 engine_g5.run_omega_g5 with resume=None = rb_g1 run_omega_g with the shadow pass; RB-G1's tests show its tree equals rb_w enginew.run_omega_w's; the shadow pass records the capacity witnesses that diagnose_cell needs and never changes the tree). One unit = one family x capacity x half (8 outcomes), its result built exactly as rb_g6 units_g6.lsr_unit builds it (rb_g1 units.summarize_outcome plus the rb_g4/rb_g5 fields), so its key and digest are comparable with RB-G5's and RB-G6's caches. F1: rb_g6 units_g6.f1_unit at the core capacity (rb_w taskb_w BrainW), plus per-row labels from a BrainW taught the same series.
core.per_row_outputs: For every training, validation and held-out row of every outcome: the core's value (exact fraction) or UNDETERMINED with its gate word, recomputed through lsr_t6 gpredict6's own steps and asserted equal to gpredict6(exact=True, gate=True, unknown_above). Stored in the unit with a sha256 of the per-row block.
core.levels: The core run's admitted levels (fit row ids and tolerance) are read from the run (rb_g3 engine_g3 run.levels_final_list) for SUB's chain receipt.
core.instrument_row: every core unit whose key also exists in RB-G5's runs (COMPLETED parts) or RB-G6's runs (COMPLETED parts, read at merge time) has an equal result digest.

gate.G_ABSENT: Always binding. RECIPE: the tree's required cells (lsr_t5 required5). RECIPE_SUB: all the outcome's real input cells (Q7 default: the gate binds for SUB). HEAD, control, baseline and MLP answers: all the outcome's real input cells. A row with a zero in any of these -> UNDETERMINED:G-ABSENT.
gate.G_LIMIT: The core's learned limits (BLEND ceiling, theoretical-yield bound, 'unknown above'). Default (Q6): binding for every head, control, baseline and the MLP on that outcome: they may not answer a row the core refused by a limit. RECIPE_SUB replaces the core tree and has no limit of its own, so it answers such rows (stated; see R-LIMIT and R-HQ-LIMIT).
gate.best_possible_gated: 448 / 512 = 87.50 points per LSR family before limit rows.

SUB.form: Y_rho = ( sum_i c_i * x_i^rho )^(1/rho) over the outcome's real input cells; rho = 0: Y = C * prod x_i^w_i with sum w_i = 1. Parameters n + 1 (5 for 4 inputs, 3 for 2 inputs, 4 for 3 inputs).
SUB.arithmetic: Python decimal, 40 significant digits, powers as exp(rho * ln x) (decimal exp and ln are correctly rounded); solves are exact over fractions of those 40-digit decimals (Gauss-Jordan, as lsr_t5 blend.inverse), solutions rounded to 40 digits. Same digits on Windows and Linux.
SUB.eligible_rows: training rows with y > 0 and every real input > 0
SUB.witness_rows: for each real input i in cell order: the eligible row (not yet chosen) with the smallest share x_i / sum of real inputs; ties by training row order
SUB.fit_per_rho: (1) witnessed solve of the n x n system on the witness rows; if singular or any c_i <= 0 (rho = 0: any weight <= 0) this rho is REFUSED (WITNESS_SINGULAR / WITNESS_NONPOSITIVE). (2) least-squares solve over all eligible rows in the same transformed space (rho = 0: log space with sum w_i = 1); kept as a candidate only if every c_i > 0. Keep the solve that reads back more training rows at the 5% standard; a tie keeps the witnessed one. Receipt field fit = WITNESSED or LEAST_SQUARES.
SUB.choose_rho: the non-refused rho whose fit reads back the most training rows at the 5% standard (all 64 training rows, value vs label); a tie goes to the smaller rho.
SUB.admission_SUB_REPLACE: against the core's final tree on that outcome: (1) gained >= 8 (training rows SUB reads back at 5% that the core does not); (2) validation hits at 5% >= the core's, and SUB's median |ln(yhat/y)| on validation <= the core's (lsr_t6 _median_log6 rule); (3) shuffled-label hold-out: validation hits on true labels > hits on labels rotated by half (rb_w enginew.rotate_labels); (4) broken <= 1 (training rows the core reads back and SUB does not); (5) gained / (n + 1) >= 1/4; (6) the receipt passes. All pass -> RECIPE_SUB; the old tree is kept with its digest.
SUB.receipt: (a) every fit row (WITNESSED: the n witness rows; LEAST_SQUARES: every eligible row) reads back at the 5% standard; (b) the n witness rows read back within 1e-12 relative; (c) CHAIN: every fit row of every level the core admitted still reads back under SUB at that level's own tolerance (lsr_t2 gexplained). Cached at admission, never recomputed.
SUB.label: RECIPE_SUB (PROPOSED shape)
SUB.variants: SUB_NO_HALF: the same with 1/2 removed from the ladder (R-SUBGEN). SUB_SEEDED: the ladder reordered to start at the sweep's rho (seed first, the rest in ladder order; ties go to the earlier rung in that order) for A2-sweep.

heads.common: Fitted on the outcome's 64 training rows only, real input cells only; one head per outcome; answers labelled HEAD:<type> with a band; never written into the recipe book.
heads.OLS_MIN: rb_w run_w.hybrid_ols, line for line, except that the fallback cell set (when the core tree is not a single MIN) is the outcome's real input cells instead of all 4 slots (ARCHITECTURE section 2: padding dropped before any head fit). Exact fractions. Parameters = number of cells. Limiting Reagent field ESTIMATED:<cell>.
heads.LOGLIN_HOM: ln y = b0 + sum_i b_i ln x_i with sum b_i = 1. Parameters n. Logs in 40-digit decimal, normal equations solved exactly in fractions, predictions via decimal exp.
heads.LOGQUAD_HOM: ln y - ln x_n = b0 + sum_{i<n} b_i z_i + sum_{i<=j<n} g_ij z_i z_j with z_i = ln x_i - ln x_n (the homogeneous translog). Parameters 1 + (n - 1) + n(n - 1)/2: 10 for 4 inputs, 3 for 2 inputs, 6 for 3 inputs. Same arithmetic.
heads.LOGQUAD_FREE: ln y = b0 + sum_i b_i l_i + sum_{i<=j} g_ij l_i l_j, l_i = ln x_i, no constraints. Parameters 1 + n + n(n + 1)/2: 15 for 4 inputs, 6 for 2 inputs. Control twin. Same arithmetic.
heads.BLEND_HEAD: lsr_t5 blend.fit_blend(real cells, train, TARGET_TAU ln 1.05, k_cap = 32) outside the admission loop (refine places corners up to the cap). Exact values. Parameters = vertices x (n + 1).
heads.KNN_HOM: control only, never a candidate: the 3 nearest training rows in mix space (shares over real inputs, L1, exact fractions, ties by row order); answer = sum of real inputs x the median of their y / sum. Parameters counted = 64 x (n + 1).
heads.HEAD_RESIDUAL: reported only (R-RES): ln(y / yhat_core) = d0 + sum_{i<n} d_i z_i fitted by least squares on training rows where the core answers with yhat > 0 and y > 0; answer yhat_core x exp(correction); exists only where the core answers. Parameters n. Label HEAD_RESIDUAL (named result Omega|corrected).

answerers.band: For a head on an outcome with m gate-passing validation rows: sort |ln(yhat/y)| and take the ceil(0.9 m)-th smallest; stored as 'B on k of m validation rows'. Band receipt: the band recomputed from the stored parameters (re-read from their serialized form) on the stored rows equals the stored band.
answerers.error_measure: err(yhat, y) = 0 if yhat == y; +infinity if exactly one of yhat, y is <= 0 or if yhat <= 0; else |ln(yhat / y)| in 40-digit decimal.
answerers.baselines_A8: rb_w run_w.run_baselines_unit's LUT, DIV_TOTAL, SMALLEST_INPUT exactly as RB-W defined them (over all 4 slots), scored behind the gate (G-ABSENT on real inputs + G-LIMIT) with ungated counts beside.
answerers.MLP: 4 -> 37 -> 1, ReLU, 223 parameters per outcome, full-batch Adam step 0.01, betas 0.9 / 0.999, eps 1e-8, 300 epochs, MSE on raw y, all 4 input slots (as RB-W built it), initial values drawn exactly as rb_w run_w.TinyMLP.__init__ with random.Random(7) per outcome. ORIGINAL: not run; RB-W's recorded per-outcome counts are the frozen comparison (ungated, laptop CPU, disclosed). FRESH: one AWS GPU job (gpu_arm). Never answers in any CAS-native arm.

routing.per_outcome_word: diagnose_cell = rb_g3 operator_g3.diagnose (the RB-G6 operator's DIAGNOSE, unchanged) applied to a one-cell stage built from the core unit's own record of that outcome (rb_g4 operator_g4.stage's cell fields). Words: AT_MARK, T1..T5 (T4a/T4b), AMBIGUOUS, NOISE, WITNESS_IN_SAMPLE_ONLY, KNOWLEDGE_MISSING, NOT_RECIPE_SHAPED.
routing.V8_overlay: A cell whose word is a T-word of kind K becomes V8_REFUSED when RB-G6's runs\MERGED.json (sha256 recorded by the merge) holds, for the same world (same world set, data family) in arm RBG, a growth event with kind K, capacity_before equal to the core capacity, outcome ROLLED_BACK and verify.V8_compactness false. If RB-G6's MERGED.json does not exist when the merge runs, the merge writes no reading (status RB_G6_MERGED_MISSING) and stops.
routing.R0: n >= 8, n = validation rows where the core answers; else stay (TOO_FEW_ROWS)
routing.R1: core hits at the 5% standard on those n rows < ceil(3n/4) (12 of 16)
routing.R2: word in {NOT_RECIPE_SHAPED, NOISE, KNOWLEDGE_MISSING, WITNESS_IN_SAMPLE_ONLY, V8_REFUSED}
routing.R3: SUB offered through SUB_REPLACE's checks; admitted -> RECIPE_SUB and no head is considered
routing.R4: over validation rows where both answer (m rows): (rows with err_head < err_recipe) - (rows with err_recipe < err_head) >= ceil(6m/16); exact ties count for neither
routing.R5: over validation rows where the head answers (k rows), for EACH of two rotations of the 16 validation labels in row order (by half: row i takes the label of row (i + 8) mod 16; by a quarter: (i + 4) mod 16): (rows with err(yhat, y_true) < err(yhat, y_rot)) - (rows with the reverse) >= ceil(10k/16)
routing.R6: head-attributable training rows (both answer, err_head < err_recipe) / head parameters >= 1/4
routing.climb_rule: take the smallest rung that passes R4, R5 and R6; move up one rung only if the next rung passes R5 and R6 AND beats the current rung by ceil(6m/16) paired validation rows (m = rows where both answer); stop at the first rung that does not. No rung passes -> stay (NO_HEAD_PASSED).
routing.sweep_in_A4s: NOT USED. The primary hybrid A4s offers SUB unseeded on every eligible outcome. Reason (DV-02): HEAD_OPTIONS section 5.7 and TEST_PLAN section 4 say any arm that uses the designed sweep rows is reported apart; that fairness rule governs over ROUTING R3's sentence that a calibrated sweep decides the offer.
routing.never: never per row, never by family name, never by held-out rows, never an at-mark outcome, never F1, never KNN, never the MLP in A4s/A4n

margins_frozen.reads_the_law: ceil(10k/16) = 10 of 16, twice (rotation by half and by a quarter)
margins_frozen.return_band: a head-routed outcome returns when its lead falls to <= 2 net paired rows; leads 3 to 5 keep the current choice (R-RET only)

shape_sweep.panel: Per outcome (clean LSR families and F1's 8 base recipes): base = the component-wise upper median (sorted[len // 2]) of the outcome's training stock vectors over real inputs; scales x1/4, x1, x4; each real input multiplied by 2^k, k = -4..4, the others held; padding slots rebuilt as the generator builds them; labels from the family's own law function (the generator's own float code), clean. c also gets a noisy panel (its noise rule with seed 2026101572), reported only. Shuffled families: no panel (no clean law to ask; DV-09). F1 base: the taught single rows of that recipe in draw 40 (ORIGINAL) / draw 60 (FRESH).
forms_in_order: FLAT: y = the base point's label, every point within the 5% standard (not an ingredient here)
COMPLEMENT: y = min(x/a, K); a = x/y at the smallest x (y > 0), K = max y
SUBSTITUTE: y = A + B x from the smallest and largest x; needs A > 0, B > 0
SUBSTITUTE_CEILING: y = min(K, A + B x); K = max y; A, B from the two smallest x; needs A > 0, B > 0
PARTIAL(rho) for rho on SUB's ladder except 1 (= SUBSTITUTE): y^rho = A + B x^rho (rho = 0: ln y = A + B ln x) from the smallest and largest x; needs every y > 0, B > 0 and (rho != 0) A > 0
THRESHOLD: y = max(0, min(x/a, K) - L) from the two smallest-x points with y > 0 (1/a = slope > 0, L > 0) and K - L = max y
INHIBITOR: y = max(0, A - B x) from the two smallest x; needs A > 0, B > 0
shape_sweep.read_rule: a form is kept only if it reads back EVERY point of the sweep at the 5% standard; the first form in order that does is the reading; none -> UNREAD. Decimal 40 digits for the fit, exact fractions for the read-back test.
shape_sweep.input_word: over the 3 scales, ignoring FLAT: none left -> NOT_AN_INGREDIENT; all COMPLEMENT/THRESHOLD -> COMPLEMENT_INPUT; all SUBSTITUTE/SUBSTITUTE_CEILING -> SUBSTITUTE_INPUT; all PARTIAL -> PARTIAL_INPUT; all INHIBITOR -> INHIBITOR_INPUT; any UNREAD -> UNREAD_INPUT; else MIXED_INPUT.
shape_sweep.outcome_word: any UNREAD_INPUT -> UNDETERMINED; ingredient inputs = inputs not NOT_AN_INGREDIENT; none -> UNDETERMINED; all in {COMPLEMENT_INPUT, INHIBITOR_INPUT} with at least one COMPLEMENT_INPUT -> MIN_RECIPE, written MIN_RECIPE+LEAK if any INHIBITOR_INPUT or any THRESHOLD reading; all SUBSTITUTE_INPUT -> SUM_CEILING if any SUBSTITUTE_CEILING reading and every ceiling K agrees with the largest within the 5% standard, SUM if no ceiling reading, MIXED if ceilings disagree; all PARTIAL_INPUT with every rho within one ladder step (index spread <= 1) -> SUB(rho*) with rho* the most frequent rho (ties to the smaller rho); else MIXED.
shape_sweep.role: a diagnostic, not an answerer; zero parameters; used only by A2-sweep (reported apart), R-SWEEP and I-SWEEP. CAS-Ohm's I-V idea and region words only; CAS-Ohm itself stays a proposed, not validated instrument.

arms.A2: RECIPE_PLUS_SUB: the core; every outcome passing R0, R1 and R2 is offered SUB (unseeded ladder) through SUB_REPLACE's checks; admitted -> RECIPE_SUB. The headline arm; same data as the tiny model. 0 neural parameters.
arms.A2_sweep: as A2 but the shape sweep decides the offer and seeds rho: SUB(rho) -> SUB_SEEDED offered; SUM or SUM_CEILING -> no new fit (the core run's own candidate generator already proposes SUM nodes; DV-06); MIN_RECIPE, MIN_RECIPE+LEAK, MIXED, UNDETERMINED, no panel -> no offer. Scored only if I-SWEEP passes; reported apart; never the headline.
arms.A3: HEAD_ONLY x each type, every outcome answered by one type behind the gate (G-ABSENT + G-LIMIT): SUB_ONLY (the chosen-rho SUB fit, no recipe checks; no fit -> UNDETERMINED:NO_FIT), OLS_MIN, LOGLIN_HOM, LOGQUAD_HOM, LOGQUAD_FREE, BLEND_HEAD; plus KNN_HOM as a control. 'Best non-neural A3 arm' = the highest of the six non-control types (KNN_HOM excluded).
arms.A4s: HYBRID_LEDGER_ROUTED: R0-R2, then R3 (SUB), then the ladder (R4-R6, climb rule). The primary hybrid.
arms.A4m: A4s with the MLP as a fifth rung above BLEND_HEAD (climb rule unchanged; R6 for the MLP: >= 56 head-attributable rows of 64). FRESH only; computed by the merge from the GPU job's per-row predictions; comparison only.
arms.A5: HYBRID_ORACLE_ROUTED, a ceiling, never a claim: per outcome, alt = SUB if SUB_REPLACE admits it on that outcome, else the ladder rung A4s would take with R1 and R2 open (R0, R4-R6 and the climb rule applied); no alt -> core. A5 takes whichever of core and alt has more held-out RIGHT (gated); a tie keeps the core.
arms.A6: HYBRID_ALWAYS_HEAD: every outcome to the ladder with R0-R5 ignored and R6 kept: the smallest rung passing R6, climbing when the next passes R6 and beats the current by ceil(6m/16) paired validation rows; none passes R6 -> core.
arms.A7: MLP (the tiny model). ORIGINAL: RB-W's recorded per-outcome counts (not run). FRESH: AWS GPU, scored gated (G-ABSENT on real inputs + G-LIMIT) and ungated by the merge.
arms.A8: LUT, DIV_TOTAL, SMALLEST_INPUT, gated, ungated beside.
arms.F1: F1 runs A1 and A4s only (A4s = A1 by construction: F1 is never routed); F1's head numbers are RB-W's, quoted (LUT 25, MLP 25).

scoring.LSR: held-out RIGHT / WRONG / UNDETERMINED per row; RIGHT = |yhat - y| <= max(1/50, y/20) in exact fractions (lsr_t1 run_t1.hit); points = 100 x RIGHT / 512 per family.
scoring.F1: points = 100 x (median B-chain RIGHT + median B-alt RIGHT) / 32 over the set's 20 draws, median as rb_g1 merge reads it (rb2 common2.median).
scoring.parameters: core: allocated (rb_g1 caps.allocated, per outcome x 16) and used (rb_w enginew.used_parameters); SUB n + 1; each head its count; MLP 223.
scoring.rows_per_parameter: per arm and per head: training rows right at the 5% standard per parameter used; per routed head: head-attributable training rows per head parameter.

family_lists.recipe_shaped_M3: scale_leak, S2v2, S3v2 and their FRESH twins, and F1
family_lists.shuffled_M8: a_approx_shuffled, scale_leak_shuffled and their FRESH twins; F1_shuffled VACUOUS (reported)
family_lists.reported_only: b and a_offladder (R-SUBGEN, R-SWEEP; b also in I-SWEEP); they enter M3's at-mark clause, M4, M5 and M7 (every family), never M1, M2 or M9 (DV-13)

HQ.ORIGINAL: on `a`: A2 uses 0 neural parameters AND A2 gated points >= (best non-neural A3 arm points - 2) AND A2 gated RIGHT >= 407 of 512, i.e. A2 points >= 100 x 417 / 512 - 2 = 79.4453125 (RB-W's recorded UNGATED MLP count on `a`: 417 of 512 held-out right, rb_w runs RB_W_MSI_W11 RESULTS_W.json; 81.45 as printed)
HQ.FRESH: on a_fresh: A2 uses 0 neural parameters AND A2 gated points >= (best non-neural A3 arm points - 2) AND A2 gated points >= (A7 gated points on a_fresh - 2). If the GPU results folder holds a GPU_ARM_NOT_RUN.json record instead of verified results, the bar is 79.4453125 and the word says PROXY_BAR. If it holds neither, the merge writes no reading (GPU_RESULTS_PENDING).
HQ.plain: within 2 gated points of the tiny model on `a`, on both world sets

M1.test: per main family: A4s points >= max(A1, A2, best non-neural A3 arm) - 2; F1: A4s answers byte-identical to A1's.

M2.test: A4s's stay/leave choice equals A5's on >= 90% of the main families' outcomes; an outcome where core and alt tie on held-out RIGHT counts as agreement.

M3.test: 0 outcomes of scale_leak, S2v2, S3v2 (and FRESH twins) and 0 F1 orders routed or SUB-replaced in A4s; and 0 outcomes in any LSR family of the set whose core is at its mark (R1 false) moved in A4s.

M4.test: every RECIPE answer comes from an outcome whose core admissions all carry a passing receipt, and every RECIPE_SUB answer from a passing SUB receipt; A4s's answer records on outcomes kept on the core are byte-identical to A1's (every LSR family of the set).

M5.test: every head answer in A4s carries its HEAD:<type> label and a band whose band receipt holds: 100%.

M6.test: rows per parameter reported for every arm, and every A4s head-routed outcome has head-attributable rows per head parameter >= 1/4.

M7.test: invented facts 0: the recipe-book digest (every core tree's canonical form and exact values) is equal before and after the head fits in every unit; writer candidates from head values 0; no arm answers a G-ABSENT row; no head value is worded as exact (head answer records carry form APPROXIMATE).

M8.test: 0 outcomes routed or SUB-replaced in A4s on a_approx_shuffled and scale_leak_shuffled (and FRESH twins). F1_shuffled: VACUOUS, reported.

M9.test: on each main family where A4s routes >= 4 outcomes to heads: those heads' points on those outcomes (100 x RIGHT / (32 x k)) beat the best gated A8 baseline's points on the same outcomes by >= 5.

disclosures: The routing margins (at-mark line 12 of 16, head lead 6 of 16, reads-the-law 10 of 16 twice, theta 1/4, return band) were set by the designer AFTER reading RB-W's results (the per-outcome held-out counts in rb_w runs RB_W_MSI_W02..W11 RESULTS_W.json). theta = 1/4 was chosen in RB-G6 after seeing RB-G5's numbers and is carried over here, not re-chosen. So ORIGINAL cannot license; FRESH governs.

RB-W's MLP numbers on ORIGINAL (the frozen comparison, e.g. 417 of 512 = 81.4453125 points on `a`) were scored UNGATED (rows with a zero input were answered) and were run on the laptop CPU inside RB-W's owner-approved LOCAL_CPU_ONCE run. RB-OH1 does not repeat that run (GPU-first rule). Because they are ungated per-outcome counts, ORIGINAL's head-to-head bar is the stricter ungated one, and A4m cannot be formed on ORIGINAL.

SUB is the generator's own family for `a` and `a_approx` (CES rho 1/2) and 1/2 is on its ladder: a win shows the shape CAN EXPRESS those laws. Only R-SUBGEN (ladder without 1/2, a_offladder, b) speaks to generality.
a_fresh is the same law as `a` with new rows.
The gate caps every LSR family at 87.50 points before limit rows.

16 checking rows per outcome make the routing margins coarse; c's checking labels are noisy; the validation rows are looked at twice (the core's VERIFY, then routing). The held-out rows never inform any fit, band, routing or sweep.

ORIGINAL worlds were seen while designing; the builder read RB-W's recorded MLP totals (to fix the HQ bar) and RB-G5 / RB-G6 cached unit wall seconds (timing only) before this freeze; no RB-OH1 number exists yet.

Cross-OS drift: SUB and the log heads use software decimal plus exact fractions (same digits on every OS); BLEND_HEAD orders corners with float logs (same OS only); the MLP is float64 on one GPU. The AWS job loads the laptop-built rows by sha256 and never regenerates data (spec section 7.37 fix).
The MLP is one network per outcome: 223 x 16 = 3,568 parameters per family.
Homogeneity is a prior every family here satisfies except b (its cap); R-SUBGEN shows the cost.

RECIPE_SUB is a PROPOSED label; the shape extends CAS v7.6 and is new matter beyond provisional 64/037,173 (owner ruling plus IP counsel before any adoption or public disclosure; Q21: private records only).
The Unity Eye is report-only here (OWNER_RULING_UNITY_EYE_ACTING_20261015.md: acting approved only in U1).
CAS-Ohm is a proposed, not validated instrument; the sweep reuses its I-V idea and region words, nothing it has measured.

Fairness of the FRESH headline: under the Q6 default the MLP (a head) may not answer rows the core refused by a learned limit, while RECIPE_SUB (a recipe) may; R-HQ-LIMIT reports HQ with the MLP allowed those rows.
